key_insight: ReTrace distills tool-using agents into reusable workflows where code selects each step, reducing repeated LLM planning overhead.
engineering_relevance: Teams automating repeated SOPs can lower runtime and cost while compiling shared rule documents for different orchestration platforms.
method: Extract action conditions from agent reasoning in a few logged runs.
Merge conditions across runs into a compact rule document.
Compile executable workflows and optionally repair them using labeled training failures.
evidence_signal: Across 79 production procedures, ReTrace achieved 93.8% completion versus the agent’s 96.8% at 24% lower cost; on τ²-Bench, it achieved 75.8% success versus 80.6% while running in 1.3 seconds versus 170 seconds.
watch_item: Initial workflows can underperform agents or few-shot generation; repair gains require labeled training failures, and compilation remains platform-specific.
paper_title: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
